# Paths that do not count toward the change-size budget (check-change-size.sh): one shell pattern per line, matched against the whole path, where * also matches /.
# Lockfiles only. A generated file counts too, unless .gitattributes marks it linguist-generated. Adding a line is a reviewed change.
pnpm-lock.yaml
*/pnpm-lock.yaml
package-lock.json
*/package-lock.json
yarn.lock
*/yarn.lock
bun.lock
*/bun.lock
bun.lockb
*/bun.lockb
uv.lock
*/uv.lock
poetry.lock
*/poetry.lock
requirements.txt
*/requirements.txt
